newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 4.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A meeting of Hungarian, Slovenian and Italian defence ministers in Ljubljana discussed the international mission to Albania.
- The industry and trade ministry is not worried that after the turn of the millenium there might be a shortage of energy.
- Hungary's parliamentary speaker is expected next week to reject three motions by independent MPs, the first time this has happened since the change of system in 1990.

- Talks are going on at the agricultural ministry between the government, the agricultiural unions and the Agrarian Council on on the basic principles of a new agricultural programme. Militant farmers' union Metesz was not present as it is organising its own demonstration in Budapest on Friday afternoon.
- The national broadcasting body the ORTT is drafting a list of social organisations which will become members of the new curatorium for the three public media.
